title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3033 203rd Street in Olympia Fields, Illinois, as the Captain Robert L. Martin Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3033 203rd Street in Olympia Fields, Illinois, as the "Captain Robert L. Martin Post Office."

summary.headline: A law that names a post office in Olympia Fields, Illinois, after Captain Robert L. Martin.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3033 203rd Street in Olympia Fields, Illinois, as the Captain Robert L. Martin Post Office. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or what postal rules apply. It is an honorary designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 21, 2019, and the naming took effect on that date.
